BEFORE WE HIT THE ROAD

A few things
to know.

Is TTSpot available now?

TTSpot is in prelaunch. KL/Selangor is the first launch focus, with interest being gathered for Johor and Penang. Launch dates and feature availability have not been announced.

How will TTPoints and rewards work?

TTPoints are planned for eligible meet check-ins, checkpoints, posts and referrals. Selected partner vouchers and community rewards will depend on verification, earning rules and redemption terms announced at launch.

Can my automotive business join?

Yes—bengkel, detailing and car-wash businesses, tyre and rim shops, tint/PPF/wrap specialists, accessory and audio shops, automotive cafés and brands can register interest. Planned opportunities include profiles, member offers, checkpoints and club collaborations.

Will my personal location be public?

Personal location sharing is planned to be off by default. Any friend, club or convoy sharing should be an explicit choice. The map preview on this page does not access or track your location.
